title: 第六章 干着三姐的事还不想承认，又当又立
content_zh:
他爷爷、父亲、母亲都是军人，从小教育他不可以伤害别人，而宣云溪的行为算故意伤害了，当时他都想把宣云溪送去警局。

    但考虑到宣云溪也受伤了，所以就送她来了医院。

    后来他仅仅让宣云溪道歉，已经算是巨大的让步，他做得够可以了。

    可没想到，宣云溪却压根儿忍不了：“我本来就不该道歉，我不道歉还成了你对我的施舍，我就该对你感恩戴德？”

    说完她又扭头看杜若依，“你说我推了你是吗？有证据吗？”

    这几年宣云溪对霍廷深伏低做小，对杜若依可是嚣张跋扈。杜若依没觉得她这样子陌生，只是委屈道：“那时你因为项链的事找我吵架，大家都听到了。”

    “然后我掉下楼梯，你晕倒在楼上，明眼人都看得出来发生什么，这证据还不够吗？”

    说着话，她眼泪啪一下子掉了下来，霍廷深立刻给她擦泪，这是下意识的动作。

    他和杜若依从小一起长大，他照顾杜若依习惯了，擦汗擦泪之类的他信手拈来。

    宣云溪咬牙看着这一幕。

    对她而言，距离和霍廷深分手不过两三天而已，在分手前她还是爱着他的。

    就算现在恨逐渐掩盖了爱，看到这两人如此亲密，她也不可能完全无动于衷。

    她只能逼自己快速从那段感情中脱离出来。

    哄好杜若依，霍廷深大步走到宣云溪面前，面色沉沉地看着她，“你只是撞到柱子晕倒，她却摔断了手。”

    “就算你是家庭主妇，也不可能不明白手对画家而言意味着什么，不是你推的，还能是谁？”

    似乎是宣云溪一而再再而三的否认让他忍无可忍，他明显动怒了，“宣云溪，别撒那么拙劣的谎言行不行！”

    看他如此愤怒，宣云溪也有一瞬间的怀疑——真是她害的杜若依？

    但她很快否认了。

    不，她不会那么做的，她相信自己！

    抬头看着霍廷深，只见他眼里慢慢都是责备，可就在“三天”之前，他对自己还全是爱。

    虽然交往期间他有点高冷，不像别的男朋友那么会哄人，可他也会任由自己撒娇，四年来他们之间也是有温情的。
content_en:
His grandfather, father, and mother were all soldiers. They taught him from an early age not to hurt others, and Xuanyunxi's behavior was considered intentional injury. At that time, he wanted to send Xuanyunxi to the police station.

    But considering that Xuanyunxi was also injured, she was sent to the hospital.

    Later, he just asked Xuanyunxi to apologize, which was already a huge concession, and he did enough.

    Unexpectedly, Xuan Yunxi couldn't bear it at all: "I shouldn't have apologized in the first place. If I don't apologize, it's your charity to me. I should be grateful to you?"

    After saying that, she turned to look at Du Roy, "You said I pushed you, right? Do you have any evidence?"

    In the past few years, Xuanyunxi has been lying low to Huo Ting, and has been arrogant and domineering towards Du Ruoyi. Du Ruoyi didn't think she looked strange, but said aggrievedly: "At that time, you had a quarrel with me about the necklace, and everyone heard it."

    "Then I fell down the stairs and you fainted upstairs. Anyone with eyesight could see what happened. Isn't this evidence enough?"

    As she spoke, her tears suddenly fell down. Huo Tingshen immediately wiped her tears. This was a subconscious action.

    He and Du Ruoyi grew up together, and he was used to taking care of Du Ruoyi. He was able to do things like wiping sweat and tears at his fingertips.

    Xuanyun Xi gritted his teeth and watched this scene.

    For her, it was only two or three days before she broke up with Huo Tingshen, and she still loved him before the breakup.

    Even if hate gradually overshadows love now, she cannot be completely indifferent to seeing these two people so close.

    She could only force herself to quickly break away from that relationship.

    After coaxing Du Ruoyi, Huo Tingshen strode up to Xuanyunxi and looked at her with a serious expression, "You just hit a pillar and fainted, but she broke her hand."

    "Even if you are a housewife, it's impossible not to understand what hands mean to a painter. If it wasn't you who recommended it, who else could it be?"

    It seemed that Xuanyunxi's repeated denials made him unbearable. He was obviously angry, "Xuanyunxi, please stop telling such clumsy lies, okay?"

    Seeing how angry he was, Xuan Yunxi also had doubts for a moment - was she really the one who harmed Du Ruoyi?

    But she quickly denied it.

    No, she won't do that, she believes in herself!

    Looking up at Huo Tingshen, he saw that his eyes were slowly filled with blame, but just "three days" ago, he was still full of love for himself.

    Although he was a little aloof during the relationship and was not as coaxing as other boyfriends, he would also let himself act coquettishly, and there was warmth between them in the past four years.
title_en: Chapter 6: I still don’t want to admit that I’m doing the third sister’s thing, and I’m pretending to do it.
